prerequisites.blockingReason: Phase 8B has 0/22 approved runtime assets, so Phase 9 has no accepted pixels from which to lock the production art bible.

waves.name: Calibration and environmental foundations
generationJobs: Produce the calibration prop and resident/environment confirmation jobs
Freeze palette, grid, anchors, depth, shadow and export profiles
completionCriteria: two independent confirmation jobs integrated consistently

waves.name: Terrain, roads, paths, water, and transitions
Reusable props, rubbish, vegetation, and effects
completionCriteria: shared rubbish reused by every applicable activity

waves.name: House families and states
completionCriteria: four lawn states resolve from data

waves.name: Player/NPC rig and population
completionCriteria: 36 resident identities render through one rig

waves.name: UI
completionCriteria: no clipped or fallback UI at supported profiles

waves.name: Interiors
completionCriteria: all interior plans and products assigned

waves.name: Minigames, one complete minigame at a time
validators: no raw filename in gameplay scene
reviewRequirements: one minigame approved before starting the next

assetFamilies.scope: Phase 8B slice plus Phase 9 ordinary-prop and resident/environment confirmation specimens
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One measured calibration set drives every later family.

assetFamilies.scope: shared no-shadow, contact, soft-ground and tall-object shadow profiles
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Shadows are profile/layer variants, never baked duplicate objects.

assetFamilies.scope: existing development checker and safe production fallback
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Reuse the central registry fallbacks; generate no scene-specific fallback.

assetFamilies.scope: town grass, meadow grass, lawn base, allotment soil and disturbed ground
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One seamless terrain family with regional palette/state variants.

assetFamilies.scope: grass-road, grass-path, soil-grass, sand-grass, pavement-road and wet-edge transitions
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Autotile transition atlas replaces hand-authored one-off corners.

assetFamilies.scope: nine roads: straights, bends, junctions, parking, kerbs and crossings
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Roads assemble from reusable topology tiles and marking overlays.

assetFamilies.scope: pavement, five winding paths, harbour walk and house approaches
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One path/paving system with material variants and transition caps.

assetFamilies.scope: Willow River, ponds, wetland and harbour water animation
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One animated water language; speed/colour are state parameters.

assetFamilies.scope: straight banks, bends, transitions, grounded rocks and reeds
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Bank rocks/reeds are edge layers; never separate scene-specific river art.

assetFamilies.scope: Commons pond, Reedbank pond, lily pads, fountain socket and fishing dock edge
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Ponds share water/bank assets and differ through modular feature sockets.

assetFamilies.scope: South Shore sand shape, wet sand, shoreline foam and harbour water transition
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Town and minigame beaches share sand/water/foam material families.

assetFamilies.scope: three bridges using deck, rail, end-cap and shadow modules
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Three bridge instances reuse one modular construction kit.

assetFamilies.scope: South Harbour docks, pier, ropes, posts and boat water sockets
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Dock pieces form both harbour world and fishing edges.

assetFamilies.scope: dense forest perimeter and openings, excluding river corridor
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Repeatable boundary clusters replace individually generated perimeter trees.

assetFamilies.scope: ambient trees plus nine released tree products; shadow/trunk/canopy, fruit/blossom/growth states
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Shared tree anatomy and layers; species are controlled variants, not whole one-offs.

assetFamilies.scope: carrot, greens, berry, mixed and sunflower crops through planted/growing/ready/harvested states
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One growth grid and anchor contract across crop species.

assetFamilies.scope: hedges, reeds, flowers, planters, meadow plants and seasonal accents
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Small vegetation shares one atlas and seasonal palette variants.

assetFamilies.scope: white fences, farm fences, gates, corners and end posts
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: All boundaries assemble from repeatable segments and sockets.

assetFamilies.scope: four released bin products plus five authored public bins; normal/full/tipped/carried states
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One functional bin family with model and state variants.

assetFamilies.scope: five standard benches/tables plus premium picnic area and seating sockets
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Shared seat geometry and occupant sockets across material variants.

assetFamilies.scope: planters, lamp, bird bath, sign, hedge, rock, clock, blankets and small fountain
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Small placeables share an atlas; night/season states are variants.

assetFamilies.scope: grand fountain, gazebo and town-centre monument placeables
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Large placeables use shared stone/timber/water modules with unique silhouettes.
assetFamilies.oneOffJustification: These are earned landmark-scale silhouettes but still reuse shared modules and effects.

assetFamilies.scope: land, river, beach, indoor and card-mode rubbish identities with clean/dirty/wet variants
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One semantic rubbish atlas is reused everywhere; cards add frames, not redrawn items.

assetFamilies.scope: ripples, foam, leaves, dust, dirt puffs, rain, snow, night glow and restoration sparkle
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Shared effects are parameterized by scene tint/scale.

assetFamilies.scope: selection, interaction, success, failure, coin/reward and restoration feedback
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One feedback vocabulary replaces per-scene success particles.

assetFamilies.scope: collection vehicle four directions, idle, driving, loading and bin sockets
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One vehicle rig serves every weekly route.

assetFamilies.scope: starter cottage, bay cottage, cross-gable, two-storey and grand-veranda kits
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Five architecture kits serve all 19 physical houses; roof/wall colours are variants.

assetFamilies.scope: clean, weathered, job-ready, restored and upgraded exterior layers
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Condition is a data-selected layer/state, never a duplicate complete house.

assetFamilies.scope: Meadowlight personal home levels 1–4 and creator roof/wall options

assetFamilies.scope: 20 lawns in fresh-cut, growing, long and job-ready states with north/south gate sockets

assetFamilies.scope: twelve venue identities without baked dynamic UI text

assetFamilies.scope: Corner Café, Grocer, Bakery, Riverside Kitchen, Willow Arms, Morning Mug, Harbour General, Riverstone, Fresh Market, Paws, Scoops and Cinema
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Each coherent façade is assembled from approved shared modules and keeps a stable door socket.

assetFamilies.scope: Community Orchard, Watermill, Commons Playground, Allotments, Reedbank Wetland and South Harbour

assetFamilies.scope: eight restoration milestones with before/after/celebration overlays
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Restoration changes layers and effects, not duplicate world screenshots.

assetFamilies.scope: shared player/NPC four-direction movement, idle and interaction rig

assetFamilies.scope: skin, hair, eyes, body, tops, bottoms and footwear from creator catalogue
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Appearance layers combine at runtime; do not generate every permutation.

assetFamilies.scope: daily, work, rain, winter and shop-linked wardrobe items

assetFamilies.scope: thought, speech, gift, carry, sit, work, cast and celebration poses/expressions

assetFamilies.scope: 35 authored NPC identities plus one owned resident recipe

assetFamilies.scope: quadruped, small mammal, bird, aerial, water, reptile and novelty-pet rigs

assetFamilies.scope: 37 species and 56 stable identity markings/directions/actions
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Identity markings are variants on species sheets, not separate rigs.

assetFamilies.scope: 11 Paws & Wonders companions, enclosure poses and selected-pet cards

assetFamilies.scope: four ornamental aquarium species and tank movement directions

assetFamilies.scope: primary, secondary, danger and icon buttons in normal/pressed/disabled/selected states

assetFamilies.scope: menus, dialogs, objective cards, reward/result, shop details, tooltips and toasts

assetFamilies.scope: coins, crops, food, fish, stars, progress, weather, day/night, friendship and restoration status

assetFamilies.scope: portrait river board, falling rubbish pieces, heavy states, snags, clears and result effects
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Pieces reuse rubbish/material tiles and one shared falling-block grid.

assetFamilies.scope: room rubbish sorting cards/bins, stain layers, five vacuum variants, vacuum movement/cleaning effects

assetFamilies.scope: boardwalk/sand/water board, umbrellas/chairs, rake/player, five groove forms, hidden finds and result effects

assetFamilies.scope: approved Reedbank background, fishing rod/line/bobber, magnet/rope, cast/reel states, catches/finds and water effects
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Fishing and magnet modes share background, casting rig, line/rope and feedback.

assetFamilies.scope: orders, trays, plates/cups, ingredients, customer bubbles, serve/discard/undo feedback and shared appliance states

assetFamilies.scope: tea/coffee/hot-water/milk ingredients, café appliances and warm dining-room skin
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Only café-specific recipes, appliances and venue skin are unique.

assetFamilies.scope: bakery ingredients, dough/prep states, ovens, baked goods and bakery venue skin
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Shared counters/trays/customers; unique baked-goods atlas and oven states only.

assetFamilies.scope: drink ingredients, coffee machines, kettle, running/burnt appliance states and coffee-shop skin
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Shares cup/order/customer assets; only drink/appliance states vary.

assetFamilies.scope: kitchen ingredients, prep, pan/oven exact-heat states, plated meals and restaurant skin
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: Shares service shell and common food components; heat/station states are variants.

assetFamilies.scope: seaside counter background, cones/cups, six ice creams, sauces, toppings, drinks, order display and serving area
assetFamilies.deduplicationRule: One coherent seaside shell contains modular product and order assets.

migrationRules: No artwork generation begins until prerequisites.executionAllowed is true.
Every candidate enters staging, validation, Asset Lab review and approval before runtime export.
Scene gameplay code references semantic IDs or prefab/layout locations, never new raw filenames.
Coordinates and gameplay geometry remain locked unless a separately approved layout change exists.
One complete wave or minigame is integrated and regression-tested before the next begins.
Approved production assets are never overwritten; revisions receive new semantic version metadata.
Reference images remain reference-only and are never pasted into interactive scenes unless contracted as a coherent whole illustration.
UI art contains no baked player-facing text.
Development tooling remains absent from production builds.
